title: Covariance recursion and full-space regression work on arbitrary faithful finite traces

statement.quantifiers: Every finite C*-algebra A, faithful normalized TRACE tau, tau-preserving UCP L2(tau)-selfadjoint r-self-compatible Phi, r>=2.
statement.assertion: One finite canonical POVM comparator Psi>=((rPhi^2-I)/(r-1))_+ and I-Psi<=2r/(r-1)(I-Phi); central-density physical EB representation is valid even for block-changing Phi.
assumptions: Actual UCP joint J and arbitrary positive central block weights.
Quadratic Hilbert operator order, not CP order.

outputs: ONE POVM controlling every Hermitian observable simultaneously, plus ordinary full-domain physical EB map.
interface.precision: Fixed-instance compact limit followed by finite convex support; no uniform convergence depth.
costs: Small block weights can worsen compactness size/measurement precision.
No uniformly bounded alphabet or efficient compiler.

proof_mechanism: Joint reference omega=tau composed J has common marginals tau and cross covariance<=I.
Physical unbiased POVM recursion on slow modes gives exact matrix covariance fixed-point H.
Regression tested against ALL observables controls omitted-mode cross terms.
First/second-moment compact hull preserves barycenter and yields finite POVM via Caratheodory.
Central sigma makes sigma E_y/tau(E_y) positive normalized preparations and identifies physical/weighted trace errors.
obstructions: Weighted noncentral reference does not imply these preparations are positive.
Interface alone does not certify upstream smoothing or centralization.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Produce an actual faithful TRACE interface and keep full-space regression rather than discard fast/slow cross terms.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed mathematics with scoped independent analytic audits; finite checks are not proof certification; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
